name: Rising
audio: a soaring choral and string melody; no speech
world: The realm is alive: swirling frost, snowflakes and ice crystals stream and swirl through the air, feathers drift down and clouds sweep past.

actions.beat: {{She}} rises upright through the centre of the great column, {{her}} wings opening wide and {{her}} arms lifted, turning gently in the light.
{{She}} turns a joyful, radiant look to the camera as the light settles and feathers drift down around {{her}}.

notes: THE DAWN, in motion: the angel rises through her element's realm.
